long_biography.plain_text:
McVicker's career developed around feeding and housing people in remote work environments. He was a principal of Morris Catering before serving as Morris Corporation's president, chairman and chief executive. The Brisbane-based business supplied catering, accommodation, cleaning and facilities management to mining and construction sites, United Nations operations and military bases, including work in Iraq.

The company expanded into a substantial Australian remote-services provider before Sodexo acquired its contracts and certain assets in 2017. McVicker then pursued agriculture at Shamrock Vale Station, acquiring the Goshu Fullblood Wagyu herd and investing in breeding and farm management. He sold the property and herd in 2021 after an eight-year tenure.
